Name: JP's Farms - Farm United - Stardew Valley United
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][b][i][size=6][color=#00ff00][u]Farm United[/u][/color][/size][/i][/b][/font][/center]

[font=Georgia]
[color=#ff00ff][size=5][i][b]Because having a huge farm is not enough if you don't have a great variety of landscapes...[/b][/i][/size][/color]
[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]This mod adds a new farm called [color=#00ffff][i]Stardew Valley United[/i] [/color][color=#f4f4f4]or[/color][color=#00ffff] [i]Farm United[/i][/color], which joins the 8 existing farms in a single map, it is for more pleasure...[/b][/size][/font][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][size=4]All farms have most of their original functions such as fishing, mining or combat. [/size][/font][/font][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][size=4]All farms are connected to each other to make it easier to travel from one to another, but you will probably need a horse or you could spend all day just to get from one side of the map to the other.[/size][/font][/font][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][size=4]As the map is very large and has several exits, the entrance from any point to the farm will take you to central areas where you can quickly access the different farms. You can also configure in which farm your spouse's area will appear.[/size][/font][/font][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][size=4]Several optional configurations to optimize individual farm space and improve overall performance.[/size][/font][/font][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][size=4]You can also add a warp zone that will help you to speed up the movement through the farm, the location of each warp represents each farm. You can go there and back.[/size][/font][/font][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][color=#ff0000][size=4][i][b]Keep in mind that this map can be very heavy for weak PCs. At first it may not seem so, but as you fill it with objects, performance may deteriorate.[/b][/i][/size][/color][/font][/font][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][color=#00ff00][size=4][b][i]Extra options to add a horse, a coop and a barn, along with two chicks and a cow, when creating a new game.[/i][/b][/size][/color][/font][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Georgia][size=4]
[youtube]wdoH3EXsotA[/youtube][/size]
